text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Vaginismus (likely secondary to body dysmorphic disorder and pelvic floor dysfunction).

I must clarify that your mention of Multiple Sclerosis is not supported by our specific findings of pain only during intercourse, lack of neurological deficits, and normal systemic review. To confirm the pelvic floor diagnosis, I am requesting the results of the Pelvic_Floor_Assessment and any available pelvic imaging.
